name: Transaction history is shown when opened right after a transaction
statusMessage: Known defect DEF-04 (see DEFECTS.md): the history is empty when it is opened in the same second as the last transaction. This depends on split-second timing, so a reliable automated check is not possible; it was confirmed with instrumented runs (evidence in DEFECTS.md).
